map.由样本标准差与测量次数求 A 类标准不确定度: Find the Type A standard uncertainty from the sample standard deviation and the number of measurements
map.输入样本标准差 s 与测量次数 n，求 A 类标准不确定度。: Enter the sample standard deviation s and the number of measurements n to get the Type A standard uncertainty.
map.📖 查看「由样本标准差与测量次数求 A 类标准不确定度 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the Type A standard uncertainty from the sample standard deviation and the number of measurements"
map.📚 深度解析：A 类标准偏差: 📚 Deep Dive: Type A standard deviation
map.s = sqrt(sum((xi-xbar)^2)/(n-1))。例：5 次测: s = sqrt(sum((xi-xbar)^2)/(n-1)). Example: 5 readings of 10.001, 10.003, 9.999, 10.002, 10.000 give s about 0.0016.
map.u_A=s/√n=1.5/4=0.3750。测量次数翻倍只能把 u_A 降到约: u_A = s/√n = 1.5/4 = 0.3750. Doubling the number of measurements only cuts u_A to about 70%, so increasing n gives diminishing returns.
map.用统计法（重复观测）评定的不确定度分量。: An uncertainty component evaluated by statistical methods (repeated observations).
map.B 类用非统计信息（证书/经验/手册）。: Type B uses non-statistical information such as certificates, experience or handbooks.
